component.name: Junk
component.summary: Super-fast multi-connection HTTP(S) downloader with arcade TUI

description.p: Junk is a pure-Rust multi-connection HTTP(S) downloader (aria2-style ranged GETs) with a neon arcade terminal UI. Progress fills a giant ASCII syringe into a junkie's arm. Distrohopper mode can send mainline ISOs straight to a mounted Ventoy stick.

ul.li: Parallel HTTP range downloads with resume
CLI: junk URL — and interactive TUI

description.p: TUI: press a auto-fills URL from clipboard; paste improvements.
Initial release: multi-conn engine, arcade TUI, Ventoy distrohopper mode.
